test_cases.name: God Component Mixing Multiple Disparate Features
test_cases.rationale: Component mixes auth, tax calculation, PDF export, and social feeds in a single file.

test_cases.name: Domain Calculations and Logic Embedded in Render Expression
test_cases.rationale: Complex tax and interest formulas are calculated directly inside inline JSX mapping.

test_cases.name: Parent Direct Mutation of Child Internal State via Ref
test_cases.rationale: Parent directly mutates childRef.current.internalValues, breaking encapsulation.

test_cases.name: Conflicting Boolean Prop Mode Flags
test_cases.rationale: Multiple boolean props (isPrimary, isSecondary, isGhost) create conflicting styling states.

test_cases.name: Deep Prop Drilling Through Intermediate Layers
test_cases.rationale: Forwarding props across 4 layers without using them creates unnecessary coupling.

test_cases.name: Generic UI Primitive Leaking Feature-Specific Special Cases
test_cases.rationale: Generic Button primitive contains hardcoded feature routing and conditional overrides.

test_cases.name: Duplicated Luhn Algorithm Across Sibling Components
test_cases.rationale: Identical credit card validation logic is duplicated across multiple sibling components.

test_cases.name: Bundling Unrelated Side Effects in Single useEffect Hook
test_cases.rationale: WebSocket connection, scroll listener, and analytics are bundled into a single effect.

test_cases.name: Untestable Component with Hardcoded Global Window Mutation
test_cases.rationale: Direct mutation of window.location prevents isolated unit testing without whole-app mocks.

test_cases.name: Fragmented Domain State Mutations by Sibling Components
test_cases.rationale: Uncoordinated direct mutation of global domain variable without an owning component.

test_cases.name: Clean Baseline - Cohesive Component with Composition and Clean Props
test_cases.rationale: Well-structured component with union variants, slot composition, and separated concerns.
